messages.subject: Problem in reading parameter file
parts:
Hi,

I wrote the parameter file based on the sample. But R can not read my last parameter. Is there any rule to write this file?  
At first I entered the parameters in Excel and then pasted in a text file. It doesnt work. I tried another way. I used a parameter file, clean the paramters one by one and wrote my own paramteres. But it can not read the last.

Many thanks,

Sedigheh Sadeghi

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: Problem in reading parameter file
parts:
Hi,

Please reply to the group not to me personally. Otherwise, other users cannot benefit from the discussion.

As shown in the output you sent:

C:/Users/PC8/Desktop/tuning/iRaceFiles/target-runner-win.bat testConfig1 2 1234567 20                                              --MaxTS 2 --alfa 21.3871 --gama 326.7762 --lclose1 19.9028 --lclose2 432.2497 --lopen1 15.5752 --lopen2 218.9551 --MaxLS 2967.9437

Irace calls target-runner-win.bat with --MaxLS 2967.9437. Thus, either target-runner-win.bat does not call target-runner.py correctly (if you haven't modified target-runner-win.bat then I doubt this is the problem) or target-runner.py does not know how to handle this parameter. My guess is that the problem is in target-runner.py. Otherwise, the problem is within target-runner-win.bat. You'll have to debug those files. Just run cmd.exe and call them directly with:

C:/Users/PC8/Desktop/tuning/iRaceFiles/target-runner-win.bat testConfig1 2 1234567 20  --MaxTS 2 --alfa 21.3871 --gama 326.7762 --lclose1 19.9028 --lclose2 432.2497 --lopen1 15.5752 --lopen2 218.9551 --MaxLS 2967.9437

No need to use irace for debugging because the problem is not in irace.

Cheers,

Manuel.
